description: This file contains a script for refactoring autoname (automatic naming) series for various DocTypes in an ERPNext system. It maps DocTypes to naming series, retrieves existing series, and updates property setters accordingly.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function that retrieves series to set and updates property setters for each DocType.

methods.name: set_series
methods.description: Updates or creates a property setter for the autoname property of a given DocType with the specified value.

methods.name: get_series
methods.description: Gathers DocTypes that exist and have a row, and for which a series to preserve is found, returning a mapping of DocType to series value.

methods.name: get_series_to_preserve
methods.description: Retrieves the current autoname series for a given DocType.
